notes: Library and Albums on the side rail are your own songs again. A tap on either one leaves the source and lands on what is downloaded, so the two glyphs named after your library open your library.
The switch says where a tap takes you - a device arrow for your downloaded songs, a waveform for the source - instead of showing where you already are.
The rail stopped moving under your thumb: the pill no longer blurs the songs behind it, and tapping a glyph marks it by changing a colour instead of redrawing the pill.
